items.title: Lebanon: The Lebanese health ministry announces that the death toll has surpassed 3,000 people, with at least 3,020 people killed and 9,273 wounded since the war with Israel began on March 2.

Brazil: 2-13 May – 2024 Rio Grande do Sul floods: At least 147 people die from flooding caused by heavy rains in Rio Grande do Sul. At least 127 others are listed as missing and 372 injured, while more than two million people in the state are affected and 600,000 others displaced.
Thailand reports a record 21 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 224.
Israel: Israel and Hamas agree to a ceasefire. The past 11 days of conflict have killed 232 people in Gaza and 11 in Israel. Egypt agrees to observe the implementation of the ceasefire.
Israel: Ten more bodies are found under the rubble of bombed buildings in Gaza, thereby bringing the Palestinian death toll to 243. Despite this, the ceasefire agreed by Israel and Hamas begins.
United Kingdom: The British death toll from COVID-19 becomes the highest in Europe at 32,313 (including suspected) after exceeding the death toll of 29,029 (excluding suspected) in Italy.
A magnitude 6.4 earthquake hits Bingöl, Turkey, killing at least 177 people and injuring 520.

Turkey: The 6.4 Mw Bingöl earthquake shook eastern Turkey with a maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent), killing 176 and injuring 520 people. More than 600 buildings collapsed or suffered heavy damage.
